name: browser-use
headline: StratArts - AI Business Strategy Skills
short_description: StratArts provides 27 AI-powered business strategy skills for Claude Code. It enables entrepreneurs and founders to develop fundable ventures with intelligent context chaining, skill iteration, and visualization options. Connects to Claude Code for business strategy optimization and planning.
author: maigentic

sections.overview:
StratArts is a comprehensive Claude Code skills library containing 27 professional skills designed to transform business ideas into fundable ventures. Built on proven methodologies like Business Model Canvas, JTBD, OKRs, and Porter's Five Forces, it guides entrepreneurs through the complete startup lifecycle—from initial idea validation to investor pitch decks. Each skill generates professional HTML reports with data-backed scoring, Chart.js visualizations, and actionable recommendations. Skills automatically detect and reuse outputs from previous analyses, enabling intelligent context chaining that accelerates business planning. Founders, entrepreneurs, and startup teams use StratArts to structure vague ideas into detailed business plans, market analyses, go-to-market strategies, and financial models in days rather than months.
Validate startup ideas with 10-dimension scoring framework
Analyze market size and competitive landscape using Porter's Five Forces
Design business models with Business Model Canvas
Build investor pitch decks with 12-15 slide framework
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/maigentic/stratarts`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a business strategist. Use StratArts to analyze [COMPANY]'s current business model in [INDUSTRY]. Identify 3 key growth opportunities and 2 potential risks. Provide a visual roadmap for the next 12 months, including milestones and resource allocation.
```
Copy

```
# Business Strategy Analysis for GreenTech Solutions
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
